title: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.12727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $\pi^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across

translated_title: Zebra3D：面向可扩展三维重建的高效混合基础模型
translated_abstract: 前馈式3D基础模型能够从无位姿图像中重建场景，但全局注意力的平方级计算成本限制了其在大规模视图集合上的可扩展性。我们提出了Zebra3D，这是一种逐层的稀疏-线性混合注意力框架，能够在无需从头训练的情况下提升预训练3D基础模型的效率。在VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror和π³上，我们观察到一种普遍一致的深度模式：早期阶段对线性替换相对容忍，而敏感的中后期阶段往往表现出更集中的注意力。Zebra3D利用这一结构，为容忍阶段分配以线性注意力为中心的注意力，为敏感阶段分配瓦片稀疏注意力，并使用地标摘要来保留未被选择的上下文。闭式仿射拟合实现了无需训练的转换，而可选的转换后训练则将任务监督与输出及关系特征蒸馏相结合。
tldr: Zebra3D提出一种逐层稀疏-线性混合注意力框架，通过为容忍的早期阶段分配线性注意力、为敏感的中后期阶段分配瓦片稀疏注意力，并利用闭式仿射拟合实现免训练转换，从而在无需从头训练的情况下显著提升预训练3D基础模型在大规模视图集上的重建效率。
en_tdlr: Zebra3D introduces a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that assigns linear-centered attention to tolerant early stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive middle-to-late stages, enabling training-free conversion via closed-form affine fitting and thus improving the efficiency and scalability of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch.
